overall_notes: The paper focuses on automated banner design generation using MLLM agents. While it generates text components (copywriting), the primary NLG task is code generation (JSON blueprints, SVG, Figma code). Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (domain-specific banner metrics + FID) and human evaluations validating the automated scoring. LLM-as-judge uses GPT-4o to score the same six criteria used in human evaluation.
